title: A relative Proj with eventually flat graded pieces is flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if the graded pieces A_d of a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra are flat over O_S for d large, then the relative Proj p : Proj_S(A) -> S is flat and the twists O_X(d) are flat over S (source lines 7824-7832). The proof reduces affine locally to the algebra statement that A_(f) is flat over R when A_d is flat for d large, which follows because A_(f) is the colimit of the A_{nd} with transition maps given by multiplication by f and flat modules are closed under filtered colimits; the same argument gives flatness of the twists.
